Выберите экран для записи. В видео попад: Select the screen to record. The video includes everything visible on that screen, including other windows and notifications.
«Как у экрана» использует размер выбранн: Match screen uses the selected screen size in pixels. 1920×1080 sets the Full HD size. Custom size lets you enter the width and height. Frame rate and compression are set separately.
VBR использует заданный битрейт: объём в: VBR uses a set bitrate: the amount of video data per second. CQP sets a quality level. With CQP, movement and detail affect the file size.
Начните с 23. Меньшее число даёт больше: Start with 23. A lower number keeps more detail but makes the file larger. A higher number makes the file smaller but can make the image less clear.
Попробуйте включить, если запись дёргает: Try this if the recording is not smooth when the graphics card is busy. The recording can become smoother, but the game frame rate can decrease.
Ширина готового видео в пикселях. Меньше: This is the width of the saved video in pixels. A lower value removes detail but can reduce the load on the computer. Keep the screen proportions to prevent a stretched image.
Высота готового видео в пикселях. Наприм: This is the height of the saved video in pixels. For Full HD, set the width to 1920 and the height to 1080. Keep the screen proportions to prevent a stretched image.
Число кадров, которые приложение пытаетс: This is the number of frames the app tries to record each second. Start with 60. A higher value can make movement smoother but makes the computer work harder.
FPS — это число кадров в секунду. Введит: FPS means frames per second. Enter a whole number from 1 to 240. If you are not sure, use 60.
Битрейт — это объём видеоданных за секун: Bitrate is the amount of video data per second. A higher value helps keep detail but makes the file larger. Start with 12 Mbps for 1920 × 1080 video at 60 frames per second.
Replay хранит последние секунды записи в: Replay keeps the most recent seconds of recording in computer memory. Press the hotkey to save that moment to a file. If memory is low, the clip will be shorter than the selected duration.
This is the computer memory limit for Replay. Start with Auto. If the memory limit is reached, the app removes the oldest frames. The saved clip can become shorter.
МиБ — единица объёма памяти. 1024 МиБ ра: MiB is a unit of memory size. 1024 MiB equals 1 GiB. A higher limit lets Replay store more video. Memory use increases as video is recorded. More memory for Replay means less memory for other apps.
В эту папку приложение сохраняет повторы: The app saves replays and recordings in this folder. Select a drive with free space. A folder change does not move existing files.
Включите, чтобы хранить все записи прямо: Enable this to keep all recordings directly in the selected folder. If disabled, the app can organize recordings in game subfolders.
MP4 открывается в большинстве плееров и: MP4 works in most players and video editors. MKV is another format that some apps cannot open. This choice alone does not improve video quality.
Выберите наушники или колонки, через кот: Select the headphones or speakers you use for game sound. The app records sound from that device, including music and voice chat. Enable your microphone separately to record your voice.
Выберите микрофон, чтобы добавить свой г: Select a microphone to add your voice to the recording. Say a few words and check the level meter. Select Do not record if you do not need your voice.
Это сочетание сохраняет недавний момент,: This hotkey saves a recent moment that has already happened. Replay must be on before the moment happens. Select keys that you do not use for game actions.
Первое нажатие начинает запись в отдельн: The first press starts recording to a separate file. The second press stops it. Recording starts when you press the hotkey and does not add earlier seconds from Replay.
Включите, чтобы записывать всё от начала: Enable this to record from the start hotkey press until the stop hotkey press. If disabled, continuous recording is unavailable. You can still save Replay clips.
При входе в Windows приложение запуститс: When you sign in to Windows, the app starts with an icon near the clock. Click the icon to open the window. This setting saves immediately.
Оверлей показывает состояние записи и ко: The overlay shows recording status and short messages on top of other windows. Use the editor to choose where they appear. This setting saves immediately.
Приложение подаёт короткий сигнал при де: The app plays a short sound for recording and Replay actions. This helps you check the action without opening the window. The sound volume is separate from the game volume.
A preset is a file name pattern. It applies to new clips and recordings. Existing file names do not change.
